from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DebtRepaymentCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Cash paid for debt repayment extracted from one company's cash flow statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name this report belongs to")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code of the company")
    cash_for_debt_repayment: float | None = Field(description="Amount paid for debt repayment; None if not reported or applicable")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. 'yuan'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024 Q1'")
    section: str | None = Field(description="Where this appears in the cash flow statement, e.g. 'financing activities'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim label or line containing this figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    debt_repayment_cash_flows: list[DebtRepaymentCashFlow]
